# RUTUBE
> Russian video platform for watching live channels, shows, movies, series, and user-published video content.

RUTUBE combines live streaming, on-demand video, thematic channels, and creator content on a large Russian-language media platform. It includes broadcasts, entertainment programming, sports, films, series, and publisher channels accessible through web and apps.

## Main Platform
- [Home](https://rutube.ru/): Main entry point for featured videos, channels, and current platform highlights.
- [Live](https://rutube.ru/live/): Directory of live channels and real-time broadcasts available on the platform.
- [Video Feed](https://rutube.ru/feeds/video/): General video feed with trending and recently featured on-demand content.
- [Channels](https://rutube.ru/channels/): Browse channel pages from media brands, creators, and publishers.
- [Shorts](https://rutube.ru/shorts/): Short-form vertical video feed for quick mobile-friendly viewing.
- [Search](https://rutube.ru/search/): Search interface for videos, channels, and topics across RUTUBE.

## Live TV and Broadcasts
- [Live Channels](https://rutube.ru/live/): Watch currently broadcasting channels and live programming in one place.
- [Stream Feed](https://rutube.ru/feeds/stream): Feed focused on live streams and ongoing broadcasts.
- [News Feed](https://rutube.ru/feeds/news): News-oriented video feed with current affairs and broadcaster clips.
- [Sport Feed](https://rutube.ru/feeds/sport): Sports-focused feed with matches, highlights, and related broadcasts.
- [Gaming Feed](https://rutube.ru/feeds/gaming): Gaming streams and videos covering gameplay, creators, and esports topics.

## Movies and Series
- [Movies Feed](https://rutube.ru/feeds/movies): Film catalog and movie-focused feed for on-demand viewing.
- [Series Feed](https://rutube.ru/feeds/serials): Series and episodic content feed from available publishers and channels.
- [Cartoons Feed](https://rutube.ru/feeds/cartoons): Animated films and cartoon content for family and children audiences.
- [Entertainment Feed](https://rutube.ru/feeds/entertainment): Entertainment programming including shows, humor, and lifestyle video.
- [Music Feed](https://rutube.ru/feeds/music): Music videos, performances, and artist-related programming.

## Thematic Content Feeds
- [Bloggers Feed](https://rutube.ru/feeds/bloggers): Creator-led content from bloggers and independent video publishers.
- [Education Feed](https://rutube.ru/feeds/education): Educational videos, explainers, and learning-oriented programming.
- [Kids Feed](https://rutube.ru/feeds/kids): Child-friendly video selection and family-oriented viewing categories.
- [Travel Feed](https://rutube.ru/feeds/travel): Travel videos, destination features, and trip-related content.
- [Auto Feed](https://rutube.ru/feeds/auto): Automotive videos covering cars, reviews, and transport topics.
- [Tech Feed](https://rutube.ru/feeds/technology): Technology-related videos, reviews, and digital product coverage.

## Channels and Creators
- [Channel Catalog](https://rutube.ru/channels/): Browse official channels, creator pages, and publisher collections.
- [Popular Channels](https://rutube.ru/channels/popular/): Discover widely watched and trending channels on the platform.
- [Subscriptions](https://rutube.ru/my/subscriptions/): Personal list of followed channels and subscription updates.
- [History](https://rutube.ru/my/history/): Viewing history for previously watched videos and broadcasts.
- [Watch Later](https://rutube.ru/my/watch-later/): Saved videos for future viewing from a personal account.

## Account and Publishing
- [Sign In](https://rutube.ru/login/): Account login page for viewers, creators, and channel owners.
- [Registration](https://rutube.ru/register/): Create a new RUTUBE account for viewing and publishing features.
- [Studio](https://studio.rutube.ru/): Creator studio for uploading videos and managing channel content.
- [Upload](https://studio.rutube.ru/upload): Direct video upload workflow for creators and publishers.
- [Channel Management](https://studio.rutube.ru/channel): Manage channel profile, branding, and publishing settings.
- [Analytics](https://studio.rutube.ru/analytics): View performance metrics and audience statistics for published content.

## Help and Support
- [Help Center](https://help.rutube.ru/): Support portal with articles about using RUTUBE and resolving issues.
- [Viewer Help](https://help.rutube.ru/): Guidance for watching videos, account access, and platform basics.
- [Creator Help](https://help.rutube.ru/category/avtoram): Help articles for authors uploading and managing content.
- [Rights Holders Help](https://help.rutube.ru/category/pravoobladatelyam): Information for copyright owners and content partners.
- [Contact Support](https://help.rutube.ru/requests/new): Submit a support request for technical or account-related problems.
- [Service Status and Issues](https://help.rutube.ru/category/obshchie-voprosy): General troubleshooting and common platform questions.

## Legal and Policies
- [Terms of Use](https://rutube.ru/info/agreement/): User agreement governing access to and use of the platform.
- [Privacy Policy](https://rutube.ru/info/privacy/): Policy describing personal data processing and privacy practices.
- [Copyright Information](https://rutube.ru/info/copyright/): Copyright-related rules, notices, and intellectual property information.
- [Community Rules](https://rutube.ru/info/rules/): Platform rules and restrictions for acceptable content and behavior.
- [Advertising Information](https://rutube.ru/info/advert/): Information related to advertising placement and promotional materials.
- [About Service](https://rutube.ru/info/about/): General information about RUTUBE as a service and platform.

## Apps and Devices
- [Mobile Apps](https://rutube.ru/info/apps/): Information about official RUTUBE applications for supported devices.
- [Android App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ru.rutube.app): Official Android application for watching RUTUBE on mobile devices.
- [iOS App](https://apps.apple.com/ru/app/rutube/id1029813784): Official iPhone and iPad application for accessing RUTUBE content.
- [Smart TV](https://rutube.ru/info/tv/): Information about watching RUTUBE on television and connected devices.
- [Device Support](https://help.rutube.ru/category/prilozheniya-i-ustroistva): Help articles for apps, TVs, and supported platforms.
